headline: Growth and margins accelerate while cash and equity decline
summary_short: Revenue rose to $2,047.9M, up 25.6% year-over-year, while operating income grew 50.5% y/y to $689.3M. Diluted EPS increased to $0.82, up 43.9% y/y, even as total cash fell 12.9% y/y to $2,934.9M.
summary_long: Revenue grew 25.6% y/y to $2,047.9M. Gross margin held near flat at 80.2% (-50bp y/y) while operating margin expanded to 33.7% (+560bp y/y) on operating income of $689.3M, up 50.5% y/y. Net income rose 37.8% y/y to $606.3M; diluted EPS increased 43.9% y/y to $0.82. Total cash fell 12.9% y/y to $2,934.9M; shareholders' equity declined 24.7% y/y to $1,551.1M.
